overall_features.embedding_text_en: A US Niagara charcoal quilted pillow-top mattress pad Listing organized around ultra-soft, cloud-like comfort. The main image emphasizes a raised quilted surface in a bedroom. Secondary and A+ images combine tactile hand-press softness imagery, side-sleeping lifestyle scenes, green natural backgrounds, airflow-arrow graphics and elastic deep-pocket fitting. The video samples repeat the same narrative: sleeping bedroom, fabric close-up, hands fitting the side skirt, palm and fingertip contact, breathability/cooling text and sleeping person. Copy progresses from softness and material/size claims to cushioning/support, installation and package recovery, washability and satisfaction. Intended expression: added bed comfort, airy/cooling feel, secure fit and easy care; hot sleepers are explicitly addressed. Reusable strategy is coordinated product close-ups, touch demonstrations, sleeping scenes and installation actions across images, video and copy. Softness, support, cooling, pain-relief, material, certification and media claims remain competitor statements, not independently verified product facts. Scope: four gallery images, seven A+ images, source copy and eight sampled video frames; ordinary description absent and audio not transcribed.
